crop.notes: The Allen item is only the short 'Sporting Note' at the top; the rest of the clipping is a railroad ad and unrelated Local Brevities.

ocr.notes: '619 Market st.' is read as '(19 Market st.'; otherwise readable.

title.suggested: Tom Allen's Saloon Notice, 619 Market Street

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat carried a notice for Tom Allen, "retired champion pugilist of the world," at 619 Market street, offering a free concert every evening with only the best singers engaged.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Tuesday Morning, October 6, 1896, page 4.

facts.fact: Allen advertised his place at 619 Market Street, St. Louis, as offering a free concert every evening, styling himself the retired champion pugilist of the world

notes: The item is a paid-style notice; the same notice appears in 944 (1896-11-21).
